meta.description: Draw geometry figures, 3D solids and LaTeX formulas on one canvas, then export a print-ready PDF, SVG or PNG. Free, in your browser, no account needed.

hero.tag: For those who teach and learn math
hero.title: Online math diagram and formula editor
hero.subtitle: Your math diagrams: simpler, faster, clearer.
hero.narrative: Build geometry figures, 3D solids and LaTeX formulas on one canvas, then export a print-ready PDF. Start from a ready-made diagram in the catalog and adapt it to your lesson, or draw your own from scratch. Everything runs in the browser: nothing to install, no account required.

sync: Language switcher synchronized with editor toolbar.

features.formulas: Visual formula editor with live preview — no LaTeX required.
features.shapes3d: 3D solids: cube, prism, pyramid, sphere, cone, cylinder — rotate them with the mouse.
features.shapes: 13 plane shapes: polygons, circles, sectors, angle markers, polylines.
features.symbols: Math symbol palette: nine categories, from Greek letters to calculus.
features.pages: Multi-page documents in A4, US Letter or 11×17 poster format.
features.export: Export to PDF, SVG or PNG — one page, a range, or the whole document.
features.draw: Freehand pencil and marker on top of any diagram.
features.tools: Groups, layers, snap-to-grid, undo/redo and keyboard shortcuts.
features.source: Save the source file and keep editing later.
features.languages: Interface in English, Russian, Spanish and German.

catalogTeaser.title: Start from a ready-made diagram
catalogTeaser.description: Browse diagrams shared by other teachers, open any of them in the editor and change what your lesson needs — the wording, the numbers, the figures. No need to start from a blank canvas.

highlightsSubtitle: Tools that keep handouts readable and printable at any scale.

visual.title: Visual formula editor
visual.description: No need to know LaTeX. Type in a math field with live preview, then restyle, rotate and move the formula anywhere on the canvas.

shapes3d.title: 3D solids you can turn
shapes3d.description: Cube, prism, pyramid, sphere, cone and cylinder rotate in real time with the mouse. Label the vertices and set face opacity so the back edges stay readable.

geometry.title: Geometry that stays precise
geometry.description: Polygons, circles, sectors, polylines, angle and side markers — snap-to-grid keeps every diagram aligned while you work.

symbols.title: Math symbols in text
symbols.description: A dedicated palette inserts π, ≅, ∈ and hundreds of other symbols straight into text — nine categories, no code hunting.

pdf.title: PDF without quality loss
pdf.description: Everything is vector, so a board poster and a student handout print sharp from the same source file.

export.title: PDF, SVG and PNG
export.description: Export the whole document, a page range, or a hand-picked set of pages. Several pages come back as a ZIP archive.

pages.title: Multi-page documents
pages.description: Tasks and answers in one file, each page with its own format and orientation. Print only the pages you need.

library.title: Formula library
library.description: Algebra, geometry and trigonometry presets — start from a common formula and adapt it instead of typing it from scratch.

steps.title: From idea to handout in four steps
steps.subtitle: No setup, no learning curve — the first diagram takes a few minutes.

open.title: Open the editor
open.description: Start in the browser as a guest. Nothing to install, no account required.

place.title: Place your figures
place.description: Pick shapes, 3D solids and formulas from the palettes, or open a diagram from the catalog as a starting point.

adjust.title: Adjust the details
adjust.description: Colors, stroke styles, angle markers, vertex labels, fonts — every element has its own properties panel.

export.title: Export and print
export.description: Save a print-ready PDF, or an SVG or PNG to drop straight into your slides.

audience.title: Who it's for
audience.subtitle: One canvas, three very different ways of using it.

teachers.title: School teachers
teachers.description: Worksheets, board posters and test papers with the exact figures and wording your class needs.

tutors.title: Private tutors
tutors.description: Quick one-off diagrams for a single lesson, saved as a source file you can reuse next time.

students.title: Students
students.description: Clean figures for coursework and presentations, exported as SVG so they scale without going blurry.

coming.title: What's coming in Pro
coming.description: These features already live in the editor and unlock with the Pro plan.

items.ai: AI assistant — describe a formula or a whole document in plain words and have it generated.
items.cloud: Cloud storage — your documents available on every device.
items.share: Share by link — send a read-only view to colleagues or students.

account.a: No. The editor opens in guest mode and keeps your work in the browser. An account is only needed to save source files you can come back to later.

latex.q: Do I need to know LaTeX?
latex.a: No. Formulas are typed in a visual math field with live preview, and the formula library covers the most common algebra, geometry and trigonometry cases. If you do know LaTeX, you can edit the source directly.

poster.q: Can I print at poster size?
poster.a: Yes. Choose the 11×17 poster format, or set each page to A4 or US Letter, portrait or landscape. Everything is vector, so it stays sharp at any size.

edit.q: Can I edit a diagram later?
edit.a: Yes. With a free account you can save the document as a source file and import it back into the editor whenever you need to change something.

price.a: Yes. The full editor, every shape and formula tool, and export to PDF, SVG and PNG are free to use. A Pro plan with AI generation, cloud storage and sharing is coming.

license.q: Can I use the diagrams in my own materials?
license.a: Yes. Whatever you build is yours — use it in handouts, slides, tests and printed materials, at school or in private lessons.
